status: APPROVED FOR OFFLINE EVALUATION ONLY - three-day window approved by user; holdout locked unless all preregistered gates pass
references: existingEnsemble(vectors.ensemble: full weighted 10-digit distribution before qualification/execution filters)

candidateFamilies.name: hierarchical Dirichlet-multinomial
candidateFamilies.config: base distribution estimated with +1 smoothing on the first half of the tuning segment; choose concentration from {0.5,1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000} by Dirichlet-multinomial marginal likelihood on the second tuning half; then update local counts sequentially

candidateFamilies.name: discounted Dirichlet (primary change-point model)
candidateFamilies.config: discount in {0.990,0.995,0.998,0.999} chosen by prequential log loss on tuning segment only; BOCPD NOT registered

candidateFamilies.name: context-tree weighting depth 3
candidateFamilies.config: 10-ary suffix context tree, maximum depth 3; each node uses symmetric Dirichlet(0.1) predictive smoothing; stop/split prior 1/2; direct target-horizon training pairs become available only after their targets are observed

candidateFamilies.name: modular increment-convolution
candidateFamilies.config: first-order Markov model on modulo-10 increments; transition rows and initial increment distribution use +0.5 smoothing; propagate the h-step sum state through the transition matrix and circularly shift from current digit. This explicitly assumes first-order Markov increments; do not describe independent repeated convolution as exact. Report tuning-only increment dependence and stability diagnostics.

candidateFamilies.name: lag-specific conditional tables P(D[t+h]|D[t-k])
candidateFamilies.config: k in {0,1,2,3,4}; min support 200 per context; Dirichlet(+1) smoothing; supported tables combined by equal-weight log-pool; unsupported tables omitted and uniform returned if no lag has support

primaryMetric: paired log-loss difference dLL = mean(LL_reference - LL_candidate), nats/forecast; positive favours candidate
multipleComparison: Holm across all 180 hypotheses; simultaneous CIs by Bonferroni at 1-alpha/m (m=180 dev/eval; m=2k holdout)

bootstrap.interval: percentile; paired forecast origins resampled together
bootstrap.pValues: one-sided paired Diebold-Mariano test with Newey-West long-run variance, lag 200; stationary-bootstrap intervals are reported separately
bootstrap.note: block-length sensitivity is reported at all three values; bootstrap intervals are not mislabeled as Holm-adjusted

splits.method: chronological per index/horizon: tuning | development-evaluation | final holdout
splits.tuning: first 20% of each index's chronological data; used for model configuration and variance/dependence estimates only
splits.developmentEvaluation: next 55% of each index's chronological data, with at least 100000 eligible paired forecasts in every index/horizon cell
splits.holdout: final 25%, locked until the selection and holdout power gates are met
splits.purge: 10 ticks removed on both sides of every boundary (applied at max horizon for all horizons)
splits.sampleNote: 181819 is the arithmetic minimum for a 55% development/evaluation share to contain 100000 origins; actual collection target must be larger to account for warm-up, the 10-tick purges, missing/invalid ticks, and forecast exclusions. The user limited collection to three days, so the seven-day calendar gate cannot pass and the holdout must remain locked.

powerGates.devEval: estimated power >= 0.70 at dLL_plan=0.001 for the full decision rule (point est >= X AND Bonferroni/Holm-adjusted CI > 0 vs both references), using paired-loss variance and dependence (effective sample via block-bootstrap/long-run variance) from the tuning segment
powerGates.holdout: >= 0.70 at dLL_plan for full promotion rule over 2k hypotheses; diagnostic power at X also reported
powerGates.extras: effects for 80%/90% power; hit-rate power at +0.5, +1, +2 pp by planting

selection.eligibility: dLL >= X vs both references AND Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 AND Bonferroni-HAC simultaneous CI lower bound > 0 vs both AND quality/leakage/calibration/stability gates pass AND sample minimum AND dev/eval power >= 0.70
selection.dataQualityGate: zero malformed rows, precision mismatches, duplicate epochs, and out-of-order rows within source pages; detected feed gaps are recorded, never interpolated, and every forecast crossing a gap is excluded
selection.calibrationGate: for each reference, candidate multiclass Brier degradation <= 0.001 and candidate 10-bin classwise ECE degradation <= 0.01; ECE bins are fixed probability intervals [0,.1),...,[.9,1]
selection.stabilityGate: at least 7 development calendar days with >=1000 eligible paired forecasts per day; positive daily DeltaLL on >=70% of those days; no single day contributes >50% of the sum of positive daily DeltaLL
selection.rankingRule: descending by min over the two references of the simultaneous-CI lower bound of dLL; ties by larger min point estimate; then lexicographic id
selection.stopRule: if none eligible, holdout is not opened; report underpowered/inconclusive as applicable

holdoutPass: for each selected cell: dLL >= X vs both references, Holm across 2k hypotheses (alpha=0.05) and Bonferroni-HAC simultaneous CIs with lower bound > 0, calibration/data-quality/stability gates pass

gapStreakNull.null: i.i.d. uniform digits (primary); exploratory only, outside the 180 family
gapStreakNull.statistic: incremental dLL of shadow gap/streak module over ensemble
gapStreakNull.surrogate: random permutation of digits within the tuning+eval segment preserving counts, 1000 replicates; serial-dependence nulls would need block surrogates and are not registered
gapStreakNull.multiplicity: classified exploratory; not used for selection

gate2IncrementDiagnostics: tuning segment only: empirical increment pmf, circular standard deviation sqrt(-2 ln R), lag-1 increment dependence, and stability across 4 equal tuning subdivisions; diagnostics do not select or remove registered candidates and create no additional predictive hypotheses
powerImplementation: paired Newey-West long-run variances/covariance from tuning loss differences; Monte Carlo bivariate normal decision simulation (100000 draws) at the fixed planning effect; Bonferroni critical cutoff across the full relevant family as a conservative approximation to Holm power
liveProtection: candidate implementations and forecasts exist only in the offline evaluation harness; no production shadow runner, no candidate code wired into the LDPE app, no import into bridge/exec/cycle/gap-trader, and no candidate can alter active forecasts or purchases. The existing eight-model ensemble remains active. Any later promotion requires separate explicit user approval after results are reported.
stackerOrFixedShare: NOT registered; would require a new manifest version
unresolvedQuestions: The three-day collection limit cannot satisfy the seven-calendar-day development stability gate or the holdout precondition; results may be descriptive or underpowered only.
R_100 has a slower tick cadence than the 1-s indices; actual eligible sample growth must be measured within the three-day window.
Deriv history API returns ~1000 ticks per request and only recent history (limits unknown); collection is restricted to the most recent three days.
Hit rate for horizon h is defined as top-1 forecast digit equals D[t+h]; confirm.
